# FDU Courses — LLM-generated structured queries

Public, read-only Fudan University course search. No login or API key is required.

The calling AI tool's LLM must interpret the user's request and generate a JSON filter object. The server validates and executes this object; it does not parse natural-language sentences. Never send the user's sentence as q or keyword.

## Contract and execution

1. Read the JSON Schema at https://fducourses.vercel.app/api/query-schema (static copy: https://dirtycomputer.github.io/fdu_courses/query-schema.json).
2. Generate and show the filter JSON. Omit unspecified fields; do not send null, extra fields, quoted numbers, or quoted booleans.
3. POST that object to https://fducourses.vercel.app/api/courses with Content-Type: application/json. If only GET is available, serialize the same object as JSON and URL-encode the whole value: /api/courses?filters=<encoded JSON>. Do not mix filters with flat query parameters.
4. Check response filters, total, returned, offset, has_more and the actual courses. A 400 is a validation error, not zero matches. Correct invalid JSON according to the error. Network failure is not evidence that no courses exist.
5. For all results, set limit=50 and offset=0; increment offset by returned until has_more=false. Stop if returned=0. Report partial results if pagination cannot be completed.

Example: 查询黄萱菁老师的所有课程

{"teacher":"黄萱菁","limit":50}

Example: 周三下午张江校区至少3学分的本科人工智能课程，最多10门

{"keyword":"人工智能","campus":"张江校区","biz_type":"本科","min_credits":3,"day":3,"period_start":6,"period_end":10,"limit":10}

Teacher names belong in teacher. Words such as 所有, 本学期 and output-format instructions are not course keywords. Preserve literal topic words. Do not infer unspecified filters.

All fields combine with AND. Space-separated keyword tokens also combine with AND. Multiple campuses/days expressed as OR require separate requests and deduplication by teaching-class id. If a condition cannot be represented (negation, exclusions, strict non-overlap, ambiguous dates or semantic expansion), ask for clarification or explicitly describe additional processing; never silently omit it.

Weekday: 1=Monday through 7=Sunday. Periods: 1-14. Morning usually 1-5, noon 5-6, afternoon 6-10, evening 11-14. Time intervals match by overlap, and weekday/period/week apply to the same session. Exact credits require equal min_credits and max_credits.

Only answer from actual API results. If unable to access the API, still return the generated JSON for the user to paste into the AI instructions page. Do not claim a query ran. If the user supplies the response JSON, use that data to answer.

## Data freshness

Report semester and generated_at for course structure. For enrolled / limit, report enrollment_updated_at, enrollment_source and any enrollment_error. live-cache means within the cache TTL (normally 300 seconds); stale-cache and snapshot are historical and must not be called real-time availability. available_only uses the latest available values, which can be stale. Do not infer enrollment eligibility.

## Other entry points

- https://fducourses.vercel.app/openapi.json — OpenAPI schema.
- https://fducourses.vercel.app/api-docs.md — REST guide.
- https://fducourses.vercel.app/api/course/{identifier} — teaching-class ID/code or course code.
- https://fducourses.vercel.app/health — dataset version.
- https://fducourses.vercel.app/mcp — native MCP clients can have their LLM generate search_courses tool arguments directly.
- https://fducourses.vercel.app/ — paste and execute LLM-generated JSON.

Migration: /api/ask no longer accepts natural-language q or {"query":"..."}. It is a deprecated alias accepting the same structured JSON body or ?filters=... only. Use /api/courses for new clients. Legacy flat GET /api/courses parameters remain supported, with q as a keyword alias.
